business_problem: Supervisors need to query extensive supervisory data and work with supervisory documents, regulations, and methodologies; accessing specific data points can require programming knowledge.
solution_summary: The ECB’s supervisory AI portfolio uses a data lake for supervisory data; the article does not identify ingestion technology, storage platform, model provider, or deployment design. For one Gen AI use case, supervisors enter natural-language requests, which are translated into scripts to locate specific data points in the lake. A separate proof of concept retrieves answers about supervisory methodology with references to internal methodologies. Athena translates and analyzes supervisory documents and combines them with public-media information; GABI generates and optimizes regression models; NAVI creates network diagrams from data from numerous sources. Heimdall supports processing information for fitness-and-propriety assessments, while Medusa supports drafting and consistency checks of reports after internal model investigations. A cloud-based virtual lab provides machine-learning capabilities and a place to share and develop code. The source names no underlying model, cloud provider, APIs, or technical integration mechanisms.
